content.snl: %The default block-renderer registry. It includes built-in renderers such as list, enumerate, matrix, table, and centered. A host can extend it with spread syntax: { ...defaultRenderers, custom: MyRenderer }.%
content.markdown: The default block-renderer registry. It includes built-in renderers such as `list`, `enumerate`, `matrix`, `table`, and `centered`. A host can extend it with spread syntax: `{ ...defaultRenderers, custom: MyRenderer }`.
